name: HHH - Fasting Reminders
_notes: LIVE on the AWS/Oracle instance (https://n8n.huntersholistichealth.com), workflow id
eCYXdae3WTGbBdO0, NOT the Railway instance. Confirmed active 2026-08-14.
SETUP (already done on the live instance):
1. n8n Settings > Variables: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.
2. Telegram credential named 'HHH Telegram Bot' using the bot token from BotFather.
3. Migration 037_telegram_fasting.sql applied in Supabase.
4. Workflow activated — checks every hour on the hour.
REMINDER LOGIC (per user, per their local timezone):
1 hour before fast starts  → warning to finish eating
At fast start hour         → fast has begun notification
1 hour before eating opens → prep reminder
At eating window open      → break fast notification
2 hours after eating opens → energy check-in (reply 1-5)
If a user has no reminder matching the current hour, no message is sent.
If no users have reminders enabled, the Code node returns empty and Telegram node never fires.
BUG FIXED 2026-08-14: 'Calculate Reminders Due Now' used $input.first().json plus
Array.isArray() to unwrap the profiles array. n8n's HTTP Request node auto-splits a
top-level JSON array response into one item per element, so $input.first().json was
already a single flat profile object, not an array. Array.isArray() on that object is
always false, so profiles was always [], on every run, at every hour, for every user.
This is why zero reminders were ever sent despite correct Supabase config. Fixed with
$input.all().map(item => item.json), which correctly collects each already-split item.
